comparison.objective: Cut a padlock shackle using a two-handed bolt cutter; candidate sets and locks a gripper opening stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Coordinated two-handle placement and closing for shearing differ from driver-and-wrench countertorque on coupled threaded parts.
comparison.success_condition: Shackle cut without dragging the lock and cutter released versus angle set, jam nut locked, and repeated retained articulation.
comparison.reason: Sharing bimanual force coordination does not make cutting equivalent to precision adjustment retention.
